name: Mordant Ghoul-Courts
identity: Cannibal ghouls who believe they are a noble court of knights. Cheap, poorly armoured hordes that refill by feasting and hit harder near their deluded kings. Each detachment is a different shared delusion.

rules.name: Marrow-Feast & Feeding Frenzy
rules.description: Marrow-Feast: once per round, after a Mordant unit destroys 1+ enemy models in melee, it returns D3 slain models (Class 1) or heals D3 MIGHT (Class 2–5), never above Starting Strength. Feeding Frenzy: Class 1 Mordant units wholly within 9″ of a friendly Mordant Leader get +1 Attack in melee.

rules.name: Gamble — Delusional Crusade
rules.description: When a Leader activates, it may suffer 2 Fatal Wounds (cannot be saved or ignored): +2 Attacks and [CRASHING] on its melee weapons this activation. (Risk: durability (voluntary).)

detachments.name: The Royal Hunt
detachments.playstyle: Delusion: the court is hunting a great beast. Monsters and knights chase big targets.

rules.name: Royal Hunt
rules.description: Re-roll Wound rolls against Class 4–5 units. Class 2–4 Mordant units get +2″ MOV in Round 1.

enhancements.name: Huntmaster's Horn
enhancements.description: **Ghoul-King on Royal Corpse-Drake** only. Re-roll all melee Wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Trophy of the Beast
enhancements.description: **Crypt-Seneschal** only. +1 Damage on a round he charged.

stratagems.name: Bring It Down!
stratagems.effect: The next friendly unit to attack it gets +1 to Hit.

stratagems.name: The Hunt Is On
stratagems.effect: One Class 2–4 unit makes a free 3″ move.

stratagems.name: Feast on the Kill
stratagems.effect: Every Mordant unit within 6″ triggers Marrow-Feast.

detachments.name: The Grand Feast
detachments.playstyle: Delusion: a royal banquet. Leaders earn Deeds and the hordes grow frenzied.

rules.name: Noble Deeds
rules.description: Each Leader gains 1 Deed per enemy model it destroys. At 3 Deeds, Feeding Frenzy from that Leader also gives +1 to Wound; at 6 Deeds it returns 1 slain Class 2 model to a unit within 6″ (once per round).

enhancements.name: Gilded Goblet
enhancements.description: **Ghoul-King of the Carrion Throne** only. Friendly units within 9″ get +1 to Wound in melee on a round they charged.

enhancements.name: Chef's Cleaver
enhancements.description: **Carrion-Surgeon** only. Stitch the Courtiers returns D3+1.

stratagems.name: Ravenous Rush
stratagems.turn: A Class 1 unit within Frenzy range declares a Charge

detachments.name: The Dragon Court
detachments.playstyle: Delusion: a court of dragon-knights. Fewer models, more monsters, flying knights.

rules.name: Dragon Lords
rules.description: Class 4 Mordant units have UNYIELDING 6+ and +1 CTRL; [FLY] units may Charge after making a full Move over terrain.

stratagems.name: Guard the Lord
stratagems.turn: A Leader is targeted within 3″ of a Class 2 unit
stratagems.effect: That unit suffers the attacks instead on a 3+.
